item.title: Telluride Ski Patrollers Union Has Raised $100K in Community Donations to Bridge Work Stoppage
item.description: The Telluride ski patroller's union issued a statement about "outside money," both as a temporary bridge through the labor dispute and as a longterm solution.

item.title: Mark Healey Explains Why He Loves Bow Hunting So Much
item.description: Mark Healey is known in our circle as one of the best big wave surfers ever. He's a lot more than that, though — he's a champion spearfisherman and bow hunter.

item.title: Skier Dies After Falling In Deep Snow Pocket at Banff Resort
item.description: On Monday, Sunshine Village shared a video to social media reporting on the recent snow conditions, saying the Banff resort is "on record watch."

item.title: Five-Year-Old Dies After Arm Trapped in Moving Walkway at Japanese Ski Resort
item.description: A five-year-old boy died after becoming trapped in a moving walkway at the Asari ski resort in Otaru, a city on the Japanese island of Hokkaido.

item.title: This Company Thinks 3D-Printed Boards Are the Future of Surfing
item.description: Swellcycle is a Santa Cruz-based startup that is developing 3D-printed surfboards using cutting-edge manufacturing technology paired with sustainable materials.

item.title: Rab Neutrino Pro Down Jacket Review
item.description: The Rab Neutrino Pro Down Jacket hits the sweet spot when it comes to packable down warmth with a touch of extra durability and weather protection.

item.title: Mount Everest Climbers Will Soon Be Required to Pay a $4,000 ‘Clean-Up Fee’
item.description: Mount Everest is famous for its beauty, majesty, and the sheer amount of garbage on its upper reaches. Nepalese authorities are trying to change that.

item.title: Telluride Says ‘Snowmaking Operations Are Underway’ as It Refines Safety Plan for Reopening
item.description: Telluride Ski Resort released a statement regarding snowmaking operations, and how it is refining its safety plan amidst a ski patrol strike.

item.title: Gabriel Medina and Longtime Sponsor Rip Curl Are Splitting Up
item.description: For nearly two decades, Gabriel Medina has been a Rip Curl guy. But in 2026, the world champion and the the iconic brand will no longer be working together.

item.title: Ben Gravy Reflects on a Decade of Sobriety and the Tragic Loss of His Unborn Son
item.description: Ten years ago, Ben Gravy decided to quit drinking. His life improved immeasurably, but tragedy struck in July of 2025. Still, his message is a hopeful one.
